description: This file is a shell script that sets up and tests a Subversion (svn) repository with specific directory operations, involving loading a dump, starting a svn server, initializing a git svn connection, and fetching updates.

methods.name: require_svnserve
methods.description: Checks for the availability of the svnserve process required for the test.

methods.name: start_svnserve
methods.description: Starts the svnserve process needed for the test environment.
